cards.title: How to read these
cards.text: Each picture shows one module on all five shapes: Bolt, Beam, Burst, Ball, Dash.
cards.why: Mark a module part as a problem if one of its five versions is wrong or boring. That's the pressure test you asked for.
cards.details:
Text order is always Bolt | Beam | Burst | Ball | Dash.

Red circles are enemies, the cyan ring is you, the cyan ball with a green health arc is your summon. Faded rings are where the dash was.

cards.title: Path modules
cards.why: One part per module, each with its picture.

parts.title: Home
parts.text: Curves to the nearest enemy | bends toward enemies | the bomb steers onto one | hunts, re-targets after each hit | the dash curves into one (a lunge).

parts.title: Bounce
parts.text: Reflects off walls | reflects | the bomb hops, blasting each hop | pinball, no speed lost | the dash rebounds and keeps going. +1 bounce a level.

parts.title: Pierce
parts.text: Through enemies | through enemies | the blast reaches through one wall | through at full speed | dash through enemies, hitting each. +1 a level.

parts.title: Orbit
parts.text: Circles you, then flies out | sweeps a full circle | blasts in a ring around you | guards you, blocking shots | the dash arcs around an enemy.

parts.title: Return
parts.text: Boomerang | swings out and back | blast expands then collapses, hitting twice | flies back; catch it for half the charge | you snap back to your start after 1 s.

cards.title: Form modules
cards.text: How many, how big, how fast. White.
cards.why: One part per module, each with its picture.

parts.title: Extra
parts.text: +1 bolt | +1 beam | +1 bomb | +1 ball | +1 dash charge.

parts.title: Grow
parts.text: Bigger bolt | wider beam | bigger blast | bigger, tougher, slower ball | wider dash that shoves more.

parts.title: Haste
parts.text: Faster shots and reload | faster ticks, longer reach | faster throw and cooldown | faster ball and summon charge | longer dash, faster recharge.

parts.title: Split
parts.text: Splits in two at its end | forks partway | two small bombs after the blast | two small balls on death | two echo dashes at ±35°. Children never split.

parts.title: Swarm
parts.text: 6 tiny homing bolts | 6 thin homing threads | 6 homing bomblets | 6 small homing balls | 6 homing sparks along the dash. Rare or better.

cards.title: Payload modules
cards.text: What a touch does. Element colours.
cards.why: One part per module, each with its picture.

parts.title: Burn
parts.text: Sets enemies on fire. At 100: Flare.

parts.title: Chill
parts.text: Slows. At 100: Freeze; a hard hit on a frozen enemy shatters it into icicles.

parts.title: Shock
parts.text: Each hit arcs to a neighbour. At 100: Overload.

parts.title: Poison
parts.text: Slow damage. At 100: Rot; it dies into gas.

parts.title: Mark
parts.text: +25% damage taken. At 5 marks: Detonate.

parts.title: Knock
parts.text: Push far | push along the beam | hurl outward | enemies fly and bowl others over | dash shoves become a shockwave.

parts.title: Pull
parts.text: Drags enemies to its line | drags them toward you | sucks in, then blasts | a magnet that gathers them | pulls them to where you land.

parts.title: Leech
parts.text: Hits heal you a little. The ball's hits heal it too. Each enemy you dash through heals you.

cards.title: Spawner modules
cards.text: Make something at a moment. Yellow.
cards.why: One part per module, each with its picture.

parts.title: Explode
parts.text: Blast on hit | blast at the beam's end every 0.5 s | a second blast | blast on death | blast where you land.

parts.title: Shrapnel
parts.text: A ring of small bolts where it ends, on every shape. +2 bolts a level.

parts.title: Gunner
parts.text: Side-shots while flying | sparks jump off the beam | the area stays and strikes fall | turret pet | 2 s of auto-fire after a dash.

parts.title: Trail
parts.text: Leaves a strip that carries its payloads (Burn makes fire): behind the bolt, the beam's sweep, a pool, behind the ball, along the dash.

parts.title: Echo
parts.text: The whole cast repeats 0.4 s later from where it was cast. A ghost ball; a ghost of you dashing.

cards.title: Rule modules
cards.why: One part per module, each with its picture.

parts.title: Link
parts.text: Bolts in a volley joined by a damaging line (alone: a whip to you) | beam ends joined | the Lightning arena ring | balls linked (alone: a flail on you) | a 1 s tripwire along the dash.

parts.title: Follow
parts.text: Bolts hover by you, then fire at what comes near | the beam locks onto what it hits | the blast becomes an aura that moves with you | finds its way to you through the maze | dash to your ball.

parts.title: Charge
parts.text: Hold to charge before release. Bigger and stronger with no cap, but less each second. Every shape.

parts.title: Ghost
parts.text: Through walls: bolt, beam, blast, ball. The dash goes through one wall if the far side is open. Legendary only.

parts.title: Rune
parts.text: On a trigger, cast the shape in its socket, with 2 slots of its own. Epic or better.

cards.title: Ghost in a maze
cards.text: Keep Ghost (through walls) as a Legendary-only module?
cards.why: It breaks the maze: bolts through walls, a dash through one wall. That's a big, fun moment once a run, but common Ghost would make the maze pointless.
cards.pick: Yes, Legendary only, and the dash goes through one wall at a time.

cards.title: Payloads on the Dash
cards.text: The Dash shoves enemies and does no damage until a module gives it some?
cards.why: Then Burn on the Dash means 'everyone you shove burns', and Pierce gives the dash a real hit. A dash that always hurts would make those modules less special.
cards.pick: Yes: no damage by default; Pierce, Explode, Trail and payloads give it some.

cards.title: Modules you want
cards.text: Any module you expected that isn't here? Add a comment.
cards.why: 28 is the first set. The four later systems (capture, origin, patterns, stage triggers) bring more.
cards.pick: Ship these 28; add yours to the later list.
